name: JM Theory Chat-Source Graft
purpose: Locate theory-bearing chat material and attach it to the matching Theory Multihub census placeholder without falsely replacing the placeholder with a completed theory body.
processing_route: full chat or source body extracted
route into existing theory body or form a genuinely distinct body
boundaries: A chat-source excerpt proves source contact and lineage, not completion.
An exact title trace is not automatically the fullest surviving chat body.
The placeholder remains an address until the source has been deeply read and routed.
Existing completed bodies receive sources and extensions; they are not duplicated by chat title.
Governance, methods, incidents and project trunks remain separately classified.
next: Search conversation history, Library files, project exports and recent chats for the remaining 166 unmatched routes, then deepen the 94 first-pass matches from excerpts into full chat/body extractions where available.
